insights.concise_text: CRAFT addresses the unknown-horizon limitation of fixed-length windows by processing comments online, and outperforms all baselines in accuracy and F1 on both datasets.

triple.subject: CRAFT
triple.object: all baselines in accuracy and F1 on both datasets

insights.concise_text: Because sequential neural models need massive unlabeled conversational data while forecasting tasks have at most a few thousands labeled examples, CRAFT uses pre-training on unlabeled data before fine-tuning.

triple.subject: relative scarcity of labeled data
triple.object: pre-training on unlabeled data before fine-tuning

insights.concise_text: The ablation trained without pre-training performs at random guessing, supporting the claim that pre-training is needed because labeled forecasting data are relatively small.

triple.subject: ablation without pre-training
triple.object: performance at the level of random guessing

insights.concise_text: CRAFT's HRED context encoder supplies the context encoding used by the predictor, enabling the model to capture relations between comments that Cumulative BoW fails to account for.

triple.subject: HRED context encoder
triple.object: the predictor with inter-comment context

insights.concise_text: The expanded `Conversations Gone Awry' dataset reaches 4,188 conversations and supplies 1 million WikiConv conversations for unsupervised pre-training of CRAFT's generative component.

triple.subject: expanded `Conversations Gone Awry' dataset
triple.object: 1 million WikiConv conversations for unsupervised pre-training

insights.concise_text: The CMV dataset's lack of post-hoc annotation limits controls, yet its 6,842 conversations are used to evaluate CRAFT against fixed-window and online baselines.

triple.subject: lack of post-hoc annotation
triple.object: controls on the 6,842 CMV conversations used for evaluation

triple.object: prediction to the latest comment

insights.concise_text: The evaluation counts a forecast as a true positive only if triggered before derailment, which operationalizes the goal of giving moderators time to intervene before harm.

triple.subject: true-positive rule
triple.object: early warning before derailment

insights.concise_text: Prior forecasting work's hand-crafted features from fixed-length windows leave the unknown-horizon problem unaddressed, while CRAFT processes comments and their relations online.

triple.subject: hand-crafted fixed-length window features
triple.object: forecasting under unknown horizon

insights.concise_text: The Wikipedia dataset's civil comments before personal attacks force models to capture conversational dynamics, aligning with CRAFT's need to model relations between comments.

triple.object: models to capture conversational dynamics

triple.object: over 50% of conversations getting at least 3 hours of advance warning and 39% getting at least 12 hours

triple.object: CRAFT using its capacity to model conversational context in an order-sensitive fashion

insights.concise_text: Shuffling comment order in pre-training, fine-tuning and testing inhibits meaningful order-sensitive dynamics and hurts performance to 65% accuracy for Wikipedia and 59.5% for CMV.

triple.object: 65% accuracy for Wikipedia and 59.5% for CMV

insights.concise_text: The two shuffling experiments jointly support the conclusion that CRAFT makes effective use of the dynamics within conversational context.

triple.subject: the two shuffling experiments
triple.object: CRAFT making effective use of the dynamics within conversational context

insights.concise_text: CRAFT's design capacity to learn an order-sensitive representation of conversational context is empirically supported by the prefix-shuffling experiment.

triple.object: CRAFT's capacity to learn an order-sensitive representation of conversational context

insights.concise_text: The model that processes comments as they happen and takes the full conversational context into account is CRAFT, whose architecture follow-up work could adapt.
